title: TeacherScoring
description: Teacher-scoring configuration: the quote-repair rule (FR-026a) and the ensemble rule (FR-019b). Kept apart from the decision criteria and frozen and hashed together with them before the first labeling run (FR-015). No value measured in a spike may set any part of it (constitution, Technical Spikes).

quote_repair.description: FR-026a: teacher scoring view only. A non-verbatim quote is replaced by the source passage it matches if the fuzzy score (0-100) is at least min_score and the passage length is within the length ratios; otherwise the item is dropped.

teacher_ensemble.description: FR-019b: offline ensemble of the single teacher candidates. Members are processed in alphabetical order of their model IDs; items are grouped by span IoU (min_iou from the pilot config), at most one item per member and group, and kept with at least min_votes members; relevance and attributes by majority vote, a relevance tie counts as relevant. Attribute ties are broken by the alphabetical order of the member model IDs; quote, actor and statement come from the alphabetically first member in the group. No order is configurable, so no spike value can enter the rule.
